title: THE RENDER WEEK · Saturday, the comments
venue: Arthur's site · a science-fiction week the papers declined · posted once, taken down
logline: Saturday, after the week was posted and taken down: the comments, drawn as the stick chorus on the desk holding up tiny wireframe versions of themselves and pointing at the discrepancies. Wood switches the monitor off. One stick figure stays lit, a wireframe. The week's only survivor is a comment.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at the beige computer. The stick chorus on the desk, each holding a tiny green-wireframe copy of itself.
